name: Trash Icon
description: Icon for delete and remove actions

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls the shake animation state. Set to true during delete operations.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one shake cycle in seconds

props.name: ease
props.description: Easing of the animation. Accepts a named ease or a cubic-bezier array.

variations.name: shake
variations.description: Lid lifts and bounces during delete operation
